examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the Functions page places it: the two-command deploy, then a curl to the domain the CLI hands back, under the headline and its install button. Edit the props in the Controls panel — an empty `session` renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Script
examples.summary: The recorded `deploy` session typed live by the terminal widget: `script` picks `start` or `deploy` and wins over `session`. The stage rises in the first time it scrolls into view, and is drawn at rest under reduced motion.
